title: Morris substance-use pattern
goal: Trace substance-use history and emotional patterns through three generations.

rubric.must: Arthur and Joan, Peter and Susan, and Caleb and Emily form three visibly ordered generations.
Alcohol-use and opioid-use condition fills are visibly distinct and associated with Arthur, Peter, and Caleb.
Caleb alone has the visible index-person double outline.
Caleb–Peter cutoff, Caleb–Susan close, and Peter–Susan conflict overlays are visibly distinct.
Names and years remain readable, including Arthur's deceased marker.

ideal.notes: Three Morris generations show alcohol-use, opioid-use, and depression fills, Arthur’s deceased cross, and Caleb’s index outline. Curved gutter ties distinguish Caleb–Peter cutoff, Caleb–Susan closeness, and Peter–Susan conflict, with the no-contact label in the cutoff break.
